items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: Lloyd, Lloyd. He played clandette now, yeah.

ctx.x: Oh, 1914. And you remember any of the drummers when you were a boy that you used to like, that you'd listen to, or follow around on parades, or any other places you'd hear them?
Lloyd Cantrell. That's where I took lessons from him. He got a son. He got a son, but his son was a baby.
